name: elevated
prompt: Edit the supplied Stonehenge museum miniature. Preserve realistic weathered grey sarsen stone materials, lichen, present-day ruined arrangement (not a reconstructed complete ring), irregular lintels and uprights, and inner/fallen stones. Change camera elevation only; show the full stone group, on transparent background with no ground, grass, pedestal, cast shadow, labels or scenery. Lighting must come from screen northwest/upper left, darker right faces. Orthographic-like long lens, restrained perspective, detailed photoreal miniature, 6% clear margins. Raise viewer slightly above the tallest lintels, looking downward around 20 degrees. Clearly see upper stone surfaces and a little of the interior circle, but retain a predominantly front view. The group has depth, not a single wall of stones.
